name: System Design Academy
summary: Curated index of system design reading: company architecture case studies, fundamentals, interview prep and AI engineering.
description: A GitHub README index of system design links, curated by the System Design Academy newsletter. Case studies show how Netflix, Uber, Stripe, Figma, Discord and 65+ other companies scale; fundamentals are grouped by technology (caching, CDN, Kafka, queues, load balancing …); further sections cover interview frameworks, an AI engineering track (AI agents, Claude Code, MCP, RAG, evals, fine tuning) and classic white papers such as Amazon Dynamo and Google Spanner.
